svg.title: 中国城市足迹底图，含南海诸岛附图
svg.metadata:
Derived overview of china-cities.v1.json · 2026-10-23-province-borders. Generalized display geometry for a city photo-album prototype. Albers equal-area projection (standard parallels 25° and 47°, central meridian 105°). The main and inset fills derive from city coverage; the province, coast and boundary strokes retain the supplied linework. Source and terms: ../../../frontend/public/map-data/NOTICE.md and LICENSES.txt. GeoCode-Release 6e3534f7af3675b19bd3c5d54c94022959dccdd2; taiwan-atlas 60ac5fdae46c53f0ddb810c418fdb08b056273d5, Taiwan county data under the Open Government Data License, version 1.0 (https://data.gov.tw/license).
